task.instruction: Prioritize telemetry work for a commerce dashboard whose teams dispute whether breadth or diagnosis is the larger gap.
task.deliverable: A telemetry priority, privacy invariant, and evidence-backed coverage boundary.

evidence.content: Synthetic instrumentation covers 9 of 12 dashboard modules, but only checkout has step-level traces.
Four invented incidents span inventory, refunds, checkout, and delivery; the checkout incident consumed 61% of diagnosis time.

A synthetic data-retention rule keeps aggregate identifiers available for cross-module diagnosis while limiting raw event retention to seven days; instrumentation coverage does not authorize a wider raw-event window.

A.content: When coverage is the limiting need, represent the important range of cases before adding detail to any one case.

B.content: When understanding is the limiting need, examine the pivotal case deeply before extending coverage.

irrelevant.content: Use consistent spacing between sections in the final artifact.
